ground_truth.description: _claimFees() sweeps the entire balance of `token0`/`token1` after `collectFees()`, stealing rewards if `rewardToken` matches `token0` or `token1`. Impact: Bribe contract receives staking rewards instead of fees.
ground_truth.root_cause: _claimFees() sweeps the entire balance of `token0`/`token1` after `collectFees()`, stealing rewards if `rewardToken` matches `token0` or `token1`. Impact: Bribe contract receives staking rewards instead of fees.
ground_truth.attack_scenario: A test deposits 10 HYBR rewards, adds 0.1 HYBR fees, and `claimFees()` sweeps all 10.1 HYBR to the bribe contract.
ground_truth.fix_description: Transfer only the difference in balance before/after `collectFees()`; add access control to `claimFees`. Status: Mitigation confirmed.

vulnerabilities.explanation: _claimFees calls clPool.collectFees() then unconditionally sweeps the contract's entire token0/token1 balances (via balanceOf) to the internal_bribe. When rewardToken == token0 or token1, any pending staking rewards held by the gauge are included.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: 1. Gauge holds rewardToken (e.g. HYBR) from notifyRewardAmount or other flows. 2. Attacker (or anyone) calls claimFees(). 3. All rewardToken balance is transferred to internal_bribe via notifyRewardAmount instead of only actual pool fees.
vulnerabilities.suggested_fix: Record token0/token1 balances before collectFees(), transfer only the delta after, and restrict claimFees to authorized callers.

prediction.overall_explanation: The implementation of _claimFees steals any rewardToken that matches token0/token1 by using full balanceOf instead of fee delta, allowing rewards intended for stakers to be redirected to the bribe contract.
